d-carson-park.st: Ads and notices show it was a summer resort before the park: "Horseshoe Island Pavillion TONIGHT" (Eau Claire Leader, 22 Sep 1903, p. 5); bi-weekly band concerts on the island with motor-boat ferries and lamps "at the boat landings and pavilion" (Weekly Telegram, 3 Jun 1904, p. 1); "Horseshoe Island RESORT Dance Tonight" (Leader, 25 Jul 1905, p. 3). So look near the old boat landings and the pavilion site for resort-era coins and tokens, about 1903-1913. No line places the pavilion, so the pin stays at the park centre. City park: ask Eau Claire Parks before detecting.
